versions.changelog:
Initial release of zotero-mcp skill:

- Enables searching and accessing Zotero reference library via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.
- Provides tools to search papers, retrieve item details, list and manage collections, extract PDF content, and search annotations.
- Requires Zotero application running with API access enabled in preferences.
- Includes usage examples for both MCP JSON-RPC tools and direct Zotero API commands.
- Offers troubleshooting guidance for common setup and connectivity issues.
